style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth, cape and loose pieces always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: A
segments.prompt: A chibi young boy knight with messy light-brown hair with an ahoge, brown eyes, a tattered olive-green cape, a steel breastplate and steel arm and leg armour over brown leather, holding a long steel longsword in his right hand, from his calm guard starts to run toward screen-right: he lowers the sword beside his hip with the blade trailing back and down, leans forward and breaks into a running stride, ending in the running pose of the last frame. Locked stationary camera, no horizontal drift. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid sword, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.

segments.name: F
segments.prompt: A chibi young boy knight with messy light-brown hair with an ahoge, brown eyes, a tattered olive-green cape, a steel breastplate and steel arm and leg armour over brown leather, holding a long steel longsword in his right hand, runs quickly in place toward screen-right: two long running strides, his two legs clearly alternating with clear foot contacts, his free arm pumping; the sword stays low beside his hip with the blade trailing back and down the whole time, never raised; scarf and cape streaming back; locked stationary camera, no drift, back to the running pose of the last frame. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid sword, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
